rawAnswer: {"findings":[{"kind":"defect","severity":"high","title":"Constructor choice now prefers fewest parameters for all types","detail":"In GetObjectInfo, when no constructor has [SerializationConstructor], candidates were ordered by descending parameter count. They are now ordered by ascending count. This is unrelated to SuppressSourceGeneration and affects every [MessagePackObject] type. A type with both a parameterless constructor and a full constructor will now get a generated formatter that uses the parameterless one plus setters, so get-only or private-set members will not be filled on deserialization.
